title: Opening a task starts before you click
description: A task's page used to load everything on it only after you clicked. Pointing at a task in the list or on the board now starts loading it, and a task you have already opened comes back at once.
items: The page looks and works as before — details, custom fields, checklist, files, subtasks, activity and history
A change you make stays on screen while it saves, instead of flicking back to the old value for a moment
A colleague's change to the task you have open appears without reloading
